steps.content: Swish... Swish...
The sound of the waves crashing on the beach is gentle and rhythmic, as if lulling the heart exhausted from work into relaxation.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Sigh... I can hardly keep my eyes open...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It must be all those back-to-back night and day shifts these days... I'm so tired I'm hallucinating... I can actually hear the sound of waves...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...Huh?! Why am I hearing waves?
The woman jolts up on the beach chair, looking around. To her surprise, she finds herself on a beach with fine white sand by the clear blue sea.
The warm air makes her skin sweat, and the light sea breeze instantly cools her down, wiping off her drowsiness.
Around her, people in beachwear are playing and laughing. Splashing water at each other, the drenched figures run past Eleven, almost bumping into her.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: This feels so good... Anyway, there's still time. I suppose a little break won't hurt.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Come to think of it, I've never seen the ocean in real life. This can be a nice research opportunity for my show. My listeners would like this sound.
Convincing herself, Eleven wanders on the beach timidly. Soon, her attention is caught by some white conches washed up by the waves.
Curious, she picks one up and places it to her ear, listening to its echoes.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I hear something inside! Are these little things the ocean's phones? Pick one up and it may connect you to the sea...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hello? Can you hear me, listeners in the sea? I bet life in such a relaxed environment shouldn't be too stressful, right?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Ah... Then, would you guys need my voice?

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: Your voice is so lovely. All my stress would be gone the moment I hear you speak!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...?! Who... who are you...?
Eleven suddenly hears a lively voice. Startled, she moves the conch away at once and searches around.
But the voice is indeed coming from the conch.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: It doesn't matter who I am. What matters is that you've arrived at Elysiland, where any wish can come true!

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: Be bold and greedy. Just indulge yourself! You can make everyone fall in love with your voice and go crazy for it. You can even make them do as you command!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Fall in love with my voice, and even... do as command? Me? Really?

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: Of course!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You're saying, these people on the beach will listen to whatever I say?

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: They will all listen to you!

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: Every word you say, they'll listen to it attentively and do as they're told, turning it into reality!

Noticing Eleven's hesitation, L.L.'s voice grows more angelic. She waves her hand, and a few colorful sparkles flash by, giving Eleven a new outfit. She goes to sit on the small "throne" on the beach.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: Come on. Try wielding your authority over the beach! You'll like it.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: Wow, it's been an hour! You're pretty tough, huh. Let's see how much longer you can stay buried!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Wait... wait a minute. It's too sunny now. Don't bury him in the sand for too long. He might get heatstroke... Help him get out.

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest A
steps.content: Oh, oh, sure. I'll dig him out right away!
Eleven made a try to advise a guest who gets too excited on his first visit to the beach, expecting him to be like her stubborn listeners who ignore her words.
But to her surprise, he didn't brush her off but instead became sensible immediately as if on command, following Eleven's advice to dig out his friend.

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: See, you did great! Your voice has power!

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: Everyone will do as you say! They should listen to you, or else there will be danger!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Be sure to warm up before going into the water. The seawater is quite cold, you may get a cramp...

steps.speaker: Elysiland Guest B
steps.content: Got it! Miss Eleven, I'll warm up now!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hey, you! Don't swim to the dangerous area! And you! Don't overeat before going into the water. Stay alert!
Eleven's voice echoes on the beach, gradually becoming different and filled with authority. The guests are also intimidated by her and all follow her instructions.
For a moment, the chaotic beach becomes orderly and safe, as if the previous uninhibited revelry was just an illusion.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It's true... Here, everything I say gets a response...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: No one pretends not to hear or understand me anymore. This is wonderful, hehe...

steps.speaker: Voice in the Conch
steps.content: Yes, that's right. Everything you say is right... As long as you're here, no one can ignore your voice... Keep going, Eleven, keep going!
Eleven clenches her hands, watching everything with excitement and a satisfied, thrilled smile. To maintain safety on the beach, her scolding and instructions echo along the shore.
